about: Every DynamoDB action the streaming function's routes (/api/brain/stream, /api/plans/chat/stream) were seen to call, by table (the deployment's table name without its prefix; main is the prefix itself) or table/index/name. services/gateway/src/routes/stream_access.rs fails when the code calls one not listed here; infra/test/streaming-access.test.ts fails when the streaming role doesn't allow one listed here.
